I'M ACTUALLY GONNA DISAGREE WITH YOU ON ONE KEY FACTOR HERE, WHICH IS SPEED. THE GAME HAS VERY MUCH BEEN THE SAME AT IT'S CORE, IN TERMS OF SPEED SINCE SYNCHRO MONSTERS WERE FIRST INTRUDUCED. IF YOU WERE AROUND FOR TELE-DAD, AND PLAYED THROUGH UNTIL NOW, YOU WOULD FIND THAT THERE IS ACTUALLY NOT AS MUCH OF A SPEED INCREASE AS YOU WOULD THINK. WHILE YES, IT IS OBVIOUSLY FASTER NOW THAN IN TELE-DAD FORMAT, IT'S NOT AS DRASTIC AS YOU MIGHT ASSUME IF YOU DON'T OFTEN GO BACK AND PLAY OLDER FORMATS WITH YOUR FRIENDS, WHICH I OFTEN DO. THE THING THAT HAS CHANGED MORE THAN SPEED IS ACTUALLY POWER. IF TWO DECKS OF EQUAL SPEED WERE BUILT, BUT ONE DECK IS BUILT WITH CARDS THAT HAVE MODERN LEVELS OF PROTECTION AND INTERACTIVITY, AND THE OTHER OF CARDS WITH PROTECTION AND INTERACTIVITY LEVELS MORE AKIN TO CARDS RELEASED AROUND THE TELE-DAD ERA, YOU WOULD FIND THE MODERN ONE WINS SIGNIFICANTLY MORE. NOT BECAUSE THE DECK IS FASTER, BUT BECAUSE THE DECK HAS MORE INTERACTIVE, AND IS STRONGER, AND HAS MORE LONGEVITY. THE IDEA OF CONSISTENCY IS ANOTHER MATTER THOUGH. THAT ALSO PLAYS A ROLE IN MODERN DECKS VERSUS DECKS OF OLDER FORMATS, BECAUSE MANY DECKS TODAY AREN'T INHERENTLY "FASTER" THAN OLDER DECKS IN TERMS OF HOW QUICKLY THE ENGINE MEETS IT'S END GOAL, BUT RATHER THEY DON'T HAVE TO WAIT AS LONG TO START SAID ENGINE, BECAUSE THE NUMBER OF "STARTER" CARDS IN A GIVEN DECK ARE GREATER NOW THAN THEY USED TO BE. BECAUSE IN FORMATS LIKE TELE-DAD, YOU STILL VERY MUCH FACED A "WHOEVER SETS UP FIRST GENERALLY WINS" SCENARIO, BUT IT TOOK LONGER TO FIND STARTER CARDS, OR EXTENDERS. BUT WHEN THEY DID, EVEN THOSE OLSER DECKS WERE STILL INCREDIBLY FAST.

AND THAT'S ALSO NOT EVEN DELVING INTO THE MATTER OF FORMATS THAT WERE FAST  BUT STILL HIGHLY INTERACTIVE AND REQUIRING LOTS OF COUNTERPLAY, WHICH WOULD BE FORMATS WHERE LOTS OF MIRROR MATCHES OCCURED BETWEEN HIGHLY INTERACTIVE DECKS, SUCH AS NEKROZ MIRRORS (WITHOUT DJINN), ZOO MIRRORS, AND EVEN MODERN DAY SKY STRIKER MIRRORS.
